navigation.title: Consulting & Agency

introduction: Consultants and agencies sell, deliver, and report, usually for five clients at once. The client work is the fun part. The admin around it is where the week goes.
Strawberry works across your inbox, calendar, client tools, and the web, and keeps each client's context separate, so the hours go to the work clients pay for.

sections.title: Why a browser, not a chatbot

blocks.text: Consulting work lives in client portals, inboxes, and a dozen tools. Strawberry works in all of them.

items: It uses each client's tools while you're logged in, and keeps each client's context separate.
It works across many tabs at once, not one click at a time.
Routines handle the monthly and weekly admin on schedule.

blocks.text: In our test of 12 real-world tasks, Strawberry scored 99.2 out of 100. Perplexity's Comet scored 90.8 and ChatGPT Atlas 73.3.

items: Turn research into a client-ready deck.
Run an SEO audit on a client's site.
Find candidates when the firm is hiring.

blocks.text: Save your way of scoping, proposing, and reporting as team skills, and every consultant works to the same standard. Put reports and time summaries on Routines, and Friday afternoons get a lot quieter.
